commit_message: Add ADR 0122 spatial audio ECS synchronization
pr_title: Continue ADR 0122 spatial audio ECS synchronization
pr_body: Continues ADR 0122 after the merged spatial-math and managed-voice slices. This slice adds engine-owned final composition between GlobalTransform, AudioListener/AudioEmitter, and the platform managed-voice API; keeps AudioVoiceId process-local; deterministically selects an enabled listener; updates moving emitter/listener gains without decode or restart; retires stale/completed voices; preserves the non-spatial portion when no listener exists; and registers the shared runtime system after transform propagation and before legacy authored-audio fallback. It does not change serialized component IDs or add the ADR 0122 priority/loop/rolloff authoring schema yet.
